chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: Denver engagement, Moten's death and Basie taking over
summary: They sort out Wichita versus Denver; Saunders brought Moten back, and after his death Basie took over the band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

No, he came back from Denver.
Oh, I thought it was Wichita.
No.
